title: The ATM gave you $5,000 too much — Part 2

hook.bottom: The ATM gave you $5,000 too much

style: Warm painterly 2D cartoon illustration, cinematic graphic-novel look: clean bold dark outlines, rich textured digital painting, soft volumetric light, deep warm oranges and moody blues, detailed environment, vertical 9:16 composition.
character: MAIN CHARACTER: a lanky ADULT man drawn as a minimalist cartoon: a perfectly round smooth tan head, two tiny solid black dot eyes set wide apart, short thin eyebrow strokes, a very small simple mouth, no nose, no visible hair, simple long limbs, dark charcoal baseball cap, oversized heather-grey hoodie, black slim pants, white sneakers. Minimal face like a webcomic, not a child, not anime, no big eyes.

scenes.A: Morning, the man walking into a bank branch holding a thick envelope of cash, determined, bright interior.
scenes.B: A tired young bank employee in a uniform at a counter looking up in shock and relief as the man hands over the envelope.
scenes.C: The young bank employee telling the story to the man, eyes teary, a cash-loading cart behind her, warm bank light.
scenes.D: Close-up portrait of the man facing the viewer, proud quiet smile, bank lobby behind him.

segments.text: You walk in before they even call back. Five thousand dollars in an envelope.
The woman at the counter goes pale. Then she starts laughing.
She's the one who loaded that machine. She's been up all night recounting.
She thought the missing money might cost her the job.
You kept your conscience clean. She kept her job. The end.
